text.does: Launch or resume a local Agreement POV on Pi or Claude; close acknowledges only.
text.use_when: Ask a fellow POV to work from its own Agreement, with an explicit purpose.
text.check: No nesting. Claude defaults to read-only; writes and permissions must be explicit. Pi read-only is unavailable. A failed child is a failed call.
text.bound: One local turn, at most 12000 reply characters. Missing runtime usage is unknown, not zero.

action.description: open: start a CLI-backed local conversation. say: resume by conversation id. close: compatibility acknowledgement only; it changes no state.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory for path resolution. Pass it when the agent has `cd`-ed into a subdir during the session — Bash `cd`s don't propagate to MCP tools, so paths otherwise resolve against the dir Claude Code launched from.

effort.description: Claude effort only, if the installed Claude Code supports --effort.

handle.description: For say/close: exact conversation_id returned by open (Pi local id or Claude UUID); supply the same runtime on say/close.

message.description: For open/say: the purpose and task, in your own words. Intent does not grant tools.

model.description: Model alias/id for the selected runtime.

permission_mode.description: Claude permission mode. bypassPermissions requires read_only=false explicitly.

pov.description: For open/say: explicit local IdeaSpace repo path with its own _agent/agreement.md; relative to cwd or absolute.

read_only.description: Claude-only restricted Read/Grep/Glob and no plugin MCP servers. Default true on Claude; pass false deliberately to allow writes.

runtime.description: Child harness, default claude. On say specify pi if open used pi.
